lines: Egypt. The richest kingdom on earth, ruled by a man who called himself a god.
Pharaoh divided the people into classes. And one group, the Children of Israel, he crushed beneath his feet.
Allah says: "Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land... slaughtering their newborn sons, and keeping their females alive."
Every baby boy born to them was killed. Soldiers went from house to house.
But Allah had a different plan. He says: "And We wanted to confer favour upon those who were oppressed in the land, and make them leaders, and make them inheritors."
And the one who would bring Pharaoh down... was about to be born, inside his own kingdom.
